messages:
alex: Heads-up — release freeze for the 1.18 train starts Thu 09:00 UTC. Please get non-blocking PRs merged by Wed EOD. Changelog link: https://redwood.internal/releases/1.18/changelog
maria: Quick question — can we extend the embeddings canary in eu-west1 to 2 hours? saw variability last time and want a longer observation window.
devon: +1 on extension. Also calling out an infra change: LB cert rotation currently scheduled Tue 23:30 UTC; that might make canary nodes flaky during startup.
jen: I can move the cert rotation to Wed 02:00 UTC to avoid overlap with canary. Confirming I'll update the infra calendar.
sre-bot: [AUTO] Canary cluster provisioning queued: canary-eu-west1 at 2026-03-26T09:30:00Z — run id run-2987
alex: Canary rollout plan: 10% -> validate latency (p50/p90) and error-rate -> 50% -> 100%. Abort if error-rate delta >5% or p90 increases >10%.
devon: Smoke tests I'll run before canary: `make smoke && scripts/check-latency.sh canary-eu-west1` — will post results here.
jen: Please ensure KV-cache priming for the canary variant (`--kv-prime=true`) — otherwise first-request latency spikes.
maria: Support coverage for the window: @oliver and @sasha will be on-call for any customer-facing issues.
release-manager: Reminder: release freeze exceptions require filing in the release exceptions doc: https://redwood.internal/release-exceptions — include owner + rollback plan.
alex: Deploy snippet for canary (for reference):
```
redwoodctl deploy --model rwd-1.5-quant --namespace prod --strategy canary --canary-weight 10
```
devon: I'm going to tail service and infra dashboards once canary starts and will post a short summary after 30m.
oliver: Ack — I'll monitor logs and the pager channel :eyes:
alex: Final reminder: last chance to land non-urgent changes is Wed 23:59 UTC. Freeze enforcement begins Thu 09:00 UTC. :lock:
sre-bot: [AUTO] Release freeze enforcement enabled at 2026-03-26T09:00:00Z
alex: (post-deploy) Canary started, reached healthy 10% in ~6m. Latency P90 +2% vs baseline (within tolerance). Continuing observations; will update after 2h as requested.
